title: Digital accessibility

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Treat access as equal participation so visual identity does not become a barrier to public services.

practical_value: Use the accessibility model alongside graphic guidance; treat the listed WCAG level as the source’s claim.
